# Jeremiah 25 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 25:12 (overlap: 9%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-it-will-be when-seventy years are-fulfilled, I-will-punish the-king-of Babylon and-that nation,' declares YHWH, 'for-their-iniquity, and-the-land-of [the]-Chaldeans, and-I-will-make-it perpetual desolations. |
| LOGOS | Then after seventy years are completed, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their iniquity, declares the LORD, making the land an everlasting waste. |
| PNEUMA | But after seventy years, I will punish the king of Babylon and his people for their sins, says the LORD. I will make Babylon an everlasting wasteland. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 25:15 (overlap: 15%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For thus says YHWH God-of Israel to-me: "Take this cup-of the-wine-of wrath from-My-hand, and-cause-to-drink-it all the-nations to-whom I send-you. |
| LOGOS | For thus the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from My hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it. |
| PNEUMA | This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from My hand this cup filled to the brim with My anger, and make all the nations drink from it. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 25:9 (overlap: 21%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Behold-Me sending and-taking all [the]-families-of [the]-north,' declares YHWH, 'and-to Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon My-servant, and-I-will-bring-them against this land and-against its-inhabitants and-against all these nations around, and-I-will-utterly-destroy-them and-make-them a-horror and-a-hissing and-perpetual desolations. |
| LOGOS | Behold, I will send for all the tribes of the north, declares the LORD, and for Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant, and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants, and against all these surrounding nations. I will devote them to destruction, and make them a horror, a hissing, and an everlasting desolation. |
| PNEUMA | I will bring King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon — yes, My servant — with all the armies of the north against this land, against its people, and against the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and contempt, a ruin forever. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
